system.description: A Focus for a performer who lifts, influences, and unites an audience.

abilities.name: Anecdote
abilities.description: Use an uplifting story to train listeners in a related task or make a neutral nearby group friendly.

abilities.name: Inspiring Suggestion
abilities.description: Give a visible, understanding ally a specific helpful suggestion; following it grants two assets.

abilities.name: Knowing the Audience
abilities.description: Read a nearby group's mood and gain an asset to investigate an individual's motivation next round.

abilities.name: Inspiring Ease
abilities.description: After a shared ten-hour recovery, your stories, songs, or art inspire allies to ease one task each day.

abilities.name: Rising Courage
abilities.description: Grant a nearby target an asset to their next Intellect defense and initiative tasks.

abilities.name: Find Motivation
abilities.description: Ignore a negative mental effect of level 4 or less, increasing the limit with Effort.

abilities.name: Perfect Stranger
abilities.description: Adopt an almost unrecognizable role, easing impersonation tasks and rewarding related Effort.

abilities.name: Calm
abilities.description: An Intellect attack using your performance prevents a living foe from attacking for one round.

abilities.name: Captivate or Inspire
abilities.description: Hold nearby NPCs' attention while speaking, or let chosen listeners perform as if one level higher.

abilities.name: Willing Sacrifice
abilities.description: When intercepting an attack for another, reduce the resulting wound's severity by one step.

abilities.name: Master Entertainer
abilities.description: Allies affected by Inspiring Ease can ease a second task daily or ease one task by two steps.

abilities.name: Vindictive Performance
abilities.description: Deliver a disguised performance that deals 6 Intellect damage and costs its target their next turn.
